When will I use this?

Indices and exponential change: when will I use this?

Whenever something doubles or halves again and again.

Vehicle body repairer

Engineering and manufacturing

\(\displaystyle t = \dfrac{8}{2^n}\)

n is the number of 3 dB steps above 85 dB

How long is safe in a 94 dB workshop?

Noise is measured in decibels. Every 3 dB more is double the noise, so the safe time halves. At 85 dB the limit is about 8 hours a day.

  1. 88 dB: \(8 \div 2 = 4\) hours.
  2. 91 dB: \(8 \div 2^{2} = 2\) hours.
  3. 94 dB: \(8 \div 2^{3} = 1\) hour.

The answer: \(8 \div 2^{3} = 1\) hour at 94 dB

Nuclear medicine technologist

Health and scienceHigher

\(\displaystyle \left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^n\)

n is the number of half-lives

How much tracer is left after a day?

The tracer used in many scans halves every 6 hours (its half-life). After 24 hours:

  1. Half-lives: \(24 \div 6 = 4\).
  2. Left: \((\tfrac{1}{2})^{4} = 1/16 = 0.0625\), so 6.25%.

The answer: \((\tfrac{1}{2})^{4} \times 100 = 6.25\%\) left after a day

Chef

Catering and hospitality

\(\displaystyle N = 100 \times 2^n\)

n is the number of 20-minute doublings

Why is food left out for 2 hours thrown away?

Uses example figures: the numbers marked (example figure) or (example figures) are made up to show the method.

Hot food must be kept at 63°C or above. Below that, bacteria can double every 20 minutes in the right conditions, which is why food left out more than 2 hours is thrown away. Start with 100 bacteria, 2 hours at room temperature (example figure):

  1. Doublings: \(120 \div 20 = 6\).
  2. Bacteria: \(100 \times 2^{6} = 100 \times 64 = 6{,}400\).

The answer: \(100 \times 2^{6} = 6{,}400\) bacteria
